bio.text: Pro-Life is the Constitution Party candidate for governor of Idaho in 2026; the Idaho Capital Sun describes him as a Constitution Party candidate who legally changed his name from Marvin Richardson to Pro-Life.
According to his campaign website, ProLife Idaho, he ran for lieutenant governor of Idaho in 2022 with the Constitution Party.

sources.title: Idaho governor's race: Pickens, Stegner say they are in it to win it
